segments.text: What: The last checkpoint of the entire 180-day plan — two unseen, full-length mock loops back to back, the closest simulation of the real thing before you sit it for real.
How to complete: Sit the mock cold, timed to 45 minutes, then score yourself against: MOCK #19 — Full loop, design 1 (unseen); MOCK #20 — Full loop, design 2 (unseen, under fatigue).

Don't move on until you can truthfully check off:
Ready criteria: no rubric dimension below 4
